title: Turk NDE 3215
content: My childhood best friend and I were huffing gasoline. We were doing this for about fifteen minutes. I just inhaled a bunch and passed the can to my friend. He said I fell over and was twitching on the ground. He said he thought I was messing around until the twitching stopped then I started to turn blue. He started to smack me in the face and I came to. I had the worst headache. While I was out, I saw my funeral I saw myself in a casket. I saw my friends and family crying and then the vision faded out. And that was when I woke up on the ground. I feel this was a NDE if it wasn't it was a real eye-opener after that I never huffed gasoline again. Do you think this was a NDE or a drug hallucination? I was really shook up by this. DID you ever hear of anything like this before? When I saw myself dead it was my fifteen year old body and all my friends and family looked like they were when I was fifteen.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Lack of oxygen to brain from huffing gasoline. Life threatening event, but not clinical death . I think it was I was on the ground passed out and I was turning blue.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal When I saw myself in the casket.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I saw myself in the casket.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did your vision differ in any way from n: I was not in my body; it was as if I was looking down at my funeral.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw all of my friends and family who were still alive.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I was very shook up. I was really upset.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes After I thought about it I felt that it was a message telling me how things could turn out for me.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Uncertain I did change, I stopped huffing gasoline.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: When you see yourself dead in a casket and you get another chance it almost makes you feel special.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Right after I told my friend who was there. He was almost as shook up as I was he thought I was dead. I told him and he believed me. I never told anyone else. My friend never huffed gasoline again.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. I saw it as a real eye-opener. It made me realize that huffing gasoline can kill you. I noticed that right away.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. I heard a show on 'Coast to Coast AM' about this. I think what happened to me was a NDE. I just wanted to see what you pros had to say about it.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: I think everything on the site is great.
